dateNote: Polled Wednesday 17 May 1961, the date the Belfast Corporation register of members gives for these results (PRONI LA/7/1/CA/1/3; Keep note "LA/7/1/CA/1/3 Part 3", photo 5); the Northern Whig printed them on 18 May.
